$comment: Design values every awsome-* surface uses. scripts/ui-check.py (C3, C9) checks the layout and the shared menu/confirm constants against this file. Change a value here first, with its source.

menu.source: shadcn/ui new-york-v4 ContextMenu spacing (content p-1 rounded-md border shadow-md; item px-2 gap-2 rounded-sm; svg size-4; separator -mx-1 my-1), made compact on a 4px scale to match the sidebar (2026-11-25, user): item row 28 like SidebarMenuButton sm, group title 24 styled like SidebarGroupLabel (11, medium, muted); text 13

confirm.source: Herdr mods/confirm (popover, radius 8, 15px semibold title, 32px buttons) with the rules in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §2.6

contrast.source: WCAG 2.2 AA; hover/selected floor agreed with the user on 2026-11-25

label.source: Herdr sidebar's six space colors; tint strength from docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §2.4

sidebar.source: shadcn/ui new-york-v4 Sidebar: SidebarGroup p-2; SidebarGroupLabel h-8 px-2 text-xs font-medium text-sidebar-foreground/70; SidebarGroupAction w-5 [&>svg]:size-4; SidebarMenu gap-1; SidebarMenuButton size sm h-7 p-2 gap-2 rounded-md; SidebarMenuBadge h-5 min-w-5 px-1 text-xs font-medium tabular-nums. Text mapped like the menu: text-sm -> 13, text-xs -> 11. Sub-agent indent follows docs/REQUIREMENTS.md §2.2 (12px a level with a guide line, as in the Files tree) instead of SidebarMenuSub's mx-3.5 + px-2.5.

settings.source: shadcn/ui new-york-v4 Item (variant outline, size sm: px-4 py-3 gap-2.5) and Field (FieldContent gap-1.5, FieldTitle font-medium, FieldDescription muted); grouped rows in one bordered card like macOS System Settings / Windows 11 Settings; sidebar rows as in the awsome sidebar. Text 13 / 12 like the rest of the app.
